selection_order: Retrospective test on an existing public experiment. The paper's outcomes are known. Raw positive-duration responses are excluded from parameter calibration, protocol selection and prediction generation; the protocol is recorded before scoring them. This is not a prospective or blinded experiment.

calibration.coordinates: Literal header/first-column Im(beta), from 0 to 5; no coordinate rescaling.
calibration.fit: Two parameters only: real alpha in [-2,2], nbar>=0; all 100 real/imaginary means equally weighted. 33 fixed starts and original-input 80-digit stationary refinement. No gain, offset, time-scale, phase or visibility fit.
calibration.difference_from_previous_packet: Use the explicitly labelled one-dimensional zero-duration scan, rather than transfer parameters from a different two-dimensional scan with ambiguous extent. Positive-duration data remain excluded.

apparatus.time_parameter: Published simulated duration K*200 microseconds; continuous pulse detuning is retained. Neither host runtime nor native pulse count is identified with this duration.
apparatus.spin_convention: down is code 0, Z=+1; Rz(+theta)=exp(-i theta Z/2)
apparatus.drive_axis_convention: H_s=delta*N-s*(Omega/2)*X_spin*(a+a^dagger), chosen from the stated positive cosine potential in position and the initialization/readout definitions. This fixes a phase convention independently of later measurements.
apparatus.paper_convention_issue: Equation 12 and Appendix equation 41 disagree in the Rz sign under the stated definitions; the displacement-phase formula also needs a quadrature offset to realize the stated x potential. The primary convention is fixed by the target positive cosine potential, not by scoring alternatives against later data.
apparatus.selection: Retain the spin through all K steps. At each requested terminal K, keep both spin-selection probabilities and condition the published comparison on down. Do not reset or postselect between evolution steps.
apparatus.environment_scope: Measured motional dephasing is a supplied environment channel. Extra preparation/measurement errors, heating and dwell-time noise are not fitted or certified.

numerics.channel_split: Symmetric dephasing half-channel, source-executed forced-oscillator unitary, dephasing half-channel.
numerics.refinement_scope: Numerical changes in predicted detector laws, not a rigorous unrestricted occupation or physical-error certificate.

validation.characteristic_scan: All 50 explicitly labelled beta coordinates, both real and imaginary components, at 2 ms and 4 ms: 200 scalar means.
validation.position_scan: All 13 explicitly labelled Im(beta) coordinates at all 39 positive durations, 0.4 through 15.6 ms: 507 imaginary means. Literal coordinates; no sqrt(2) or factor-two rescaling.
validation.two_dimensional_scans: Archived for provenance only; not scored in this protocol.
validation.zero_duration_position_scan: Independent preparation diagnostic, excluded from the fit and from the positive-duration score.

controls: Frozen prepared state with the same detector settings at every requested duration.
Harmonic evolution plus the same dephasing, with the anharmonic drive removed; no fit to later data.
Full pulse sequence with zero dephasing, as a declared sensitivity control.

scoring.primary: Equal-weight descriptive RMSE over raw spin means; binary-probability RMSE is half this value. Report each data family separately and all 707 means together.
scoring.derived_position: OLS slope of the 13 imaginary means against literal Im(beta), divided by sqrt(2); diagnostic only, not independent evidence.
scoring.all_outcomes: Retain accepted and rejected selection masses and both conditional detector probabilities; do not compare unconditional predictions to conditioned experimental means.
scoring.uncertainty: No significance claim: preparation uncertainty, accepted shot counts and full apparatus errors are not authenticated. Nominal paper shot counts do not supply a certified likelihood here.
